name: Seoul
about: Spring cherry blossoms and fall foliage are the highlights, summer is hot/humid with monsoon rain, winter is cold and dry.
overview: A hyper-modern megacity of palaces, K-pop culture, and some of Asia's best street food and shopping.
costOverview: Subway rides, palace admission, and casual meals all stay notably cheap for a city this size and polish.

specialSeasons.text: Cherry blossoms bloom around the city, especially along the Han River and old palaces.
Fall foliage peaks in the mountains and palace gardens around the city.
